thread:
ana_growth: Quick sync — finalizing launch post + benchmark narrative. Need 2 chart options (one simple headline-friendly graphic, one technical appendix chart) and final microcopy for CTA. Audience: infra/platform engineers + early-stage startups.

sara_marketing: Got it. For the headline graphic, can we show 'latency-to-dollar' snapshot? Simple stat e.g., "median latency 45ms — ~ $0.002/token" and a tiny 2-bar viz: hosted vs dedicated costs.

lee_design: I'll mock two tiles: 1) single stat + single CTA, 2) split viz w/line for p50/p95 and stacked bar for cost per 1k tokens. Leaning minimalist.

jordan_data: Two data notes — headline viz uses aggregated 1M requests sample; appendix chart = latency CDF per model size. Quick snippet for the appendix labels:

```
x: latency_ms_percentile
y: cumulative_fraction
color: model_variant
```

mike_product: For messaging — keep claims measurable and prescriptive. Don't say "cheaper" alone. Try: "Reduce per-call cost up to 40% with batching + prefix caching". Also suggest routing copy for inbound: tags = ["SLA-sensitive","Startup","Enterprise-eval"].

ana_growth: Love that. Microcopy options for CTA (short):
- "See the numbers — get the benchmark"
- "Compare latency & cost"
- "Run your slice (free credit)"

sara_marketing: My pick: "Compare latency & cost" for the headline CTA; it's approachable and product-aligned. Secondary: "Run your slice (free credit)" for devs who want hands-on.

lee_design: Updated comps uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/xxxx — two artboards named "headline-snap" and "appendix-cdf". Added alt text notes for accessibility.

jordan_data: One more ask: include a small table for assumptions: token lengths (prompt 64, completion 128), batching window 8ms, GPU type A100. I'll attach CSV to the appendix.

mike_product: Webinar hook: 20-min demo + 10-min Q&A. Segment register flow by interest (ops vs product) and route leads: ops -> AE_ops, product -> AE_pm. Use tags Jordan suggested to auto-route.

ana_growth: Timing — final draft by EOD Wed, review Thu morning, publish next Tue. I'll write the launch post draft using the headline CTA and the short bullet list of benefits.

opsbot: Notice: shared Figma link modified by lee_design at 2025-04-02T14:12:03Z :pushpin:

sara_marketing: tiny copy tweak request: change "per-call" to "per-request" for clarity. Also can we A/B test microcopy for 48 hours post-launch? :chart_with_upwards_trend: 

ana_growth: Yep to both. A/B test variants: CTA A = "Compare latency & cost"; CTA B = "See the numbers — get the benchmark". We'll route 50/50 and measure CTR -> signups.

mike_product: For inbound form, add checkbox "Interested in dedicated capacity" to trigger a higher-touch workflow.

jordan_data: I'll prepare the measurement plan: CTR, signups, trial runs, and lead score by tag. Deliverable by Fri noon.

ana_growth: Great work. Final note for the launch post intro: keep technical callouts concise, point to appendix for full methodology and raw CSV. Thanks everyone :party:
